description: Find what is special about a whole number from 0 to 10^18. Tests primality exactly (deterministic Miller-Rabin with BigInt), factorises it (trial division then Pollard's rho), counts and adds its divisors, and checks 30 named properties: perfect, abundant and deficient; Mersenne, twin and emirp primes; taxicab, Carmichael, Kaprekar, Smith, Harshad, happy, Armstrong, Fibonacci, Lucas, Catalan, triangular, square, cube, factorial, palindrome, sum of two squares, Kaprekar's routine to 6174 and more. Each property comes back with holds true or false and a one-line reason. Also returns binary, hex, Roman numerals (empty outside 1 to 3,999), digit sum and the previous and next primes. n, factor primes, the divisor sum and the primes come back as strings of digits. Send n above 9,007,199,254,740,991 as a string. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/number-facts-finder/

n.description: A whole number from 0 to 1000000000000000000 (10^18), such as 1729 or "2026". Commas, spaces or underscores may separate groups of 3 digits, as in "1,000,000"; a list such as "6, 28, 496" is rejected, so send one number per call. Send values above 9,007,199,254,740,991 as a string to keep every digit
